name: Valheim
description: Valheim dedicated server using the lloesche image with automatic backups disabled (use Porgous backups).

install.script:
set -e
mkdir -p config data
echo 'Valheim server files are downloaded by the container image on first start.'
echo 'Install complete'

variables.name: Join password
variables.description: At least 5 characters; Valheim rejects empty passwords on public servers.

notes: Valheim needs all three consecutive UDP ports. Allocate them on the same node.
